title: Shared review definitions
description: Severity, category, location, and finding definitions shared by the specialist and aggregate schemas. Change severity meanings here only. The deterministic tool (scripts/spk_review.py) enforces the invariants that JSON Schema cannot express: title length, word budget, evidence for warning and severe findings, line order, and computed counts.

level.description: severe: a verified defect that must be fixed before merge. warning: a defect the author should fix; it does not block merge. question: a question the author must answer to decide whether a defect exists. Blocking is computed from verified severe findings, never declared.

category.description: style findings are not published by default; they belong to configured lint tools.

confidence.description: Diagnostic only. It is stored in the local review file and never rendered on GitHub.

file_path.description: Path relative to the repository root

side.description: new for added or current lines, old for deleted lines

end_line.description: Must be >= start_line. The tool checks this.

title.description: One plain sentence naming the problem. Not a category label.

problem.description: One sentence: the concrete trigger. Name the function, value, or line.

consequence.description: One sentence: what goes wrong for users, data, or operators.

fix.description: One sentence: what to change. Required for warning and severe.

fix_caveat.description: Only when the fix changes how it must be applied: deploy order, locks, callers to update. Omit otherwise.

evidence.description: Quotes from the reviewed revision in the form `path:line: code`. Required for warning and severe.

introduced_by_pr.description: true only when this PR introduces the problem. Pre-existing issues are not published.

cross_cutting.description: true when the finding spans files, services, or deployment steps.

dedupe_key.description: category|issue_slug|primary_file[|symbol|lines]. The first three segments form the stable finding identity.
